My plot is only 0.12 hectares, so I must be very careful with every shilling I spend. I will plant the maize seed I saved from last season because buying improved seed is too expensive for such a small piece of land, and without fertilizer it does not pay off anyway. I cannot afford a full bag of chemical fertilizer — one bag costs too much and would be more than my plot needs — so I will not buy any. But I will carry manure from my homestead and spread it on this plot because the land is mine and I want to keep the soil strong for the future. I will do all the work myself with help from my family; the plot is small enough that I do not need to hire anyone, and I have no extra cash for wages.
